## v0.16

- Tony Hawk 4 now boots to its menus. The game's screen copy was queued by the OS but never completed, so the display stayed white while the game ran (you could hear the audio). The copy is now done immediately.
- Removed the earlier v0.15 workaround for the busy-wait hang; this replaces it.
- Note: the game's first load takes a while; the title and publisher screens appear first.
